event_name: Logroño auto de fe burns Zugarramurdi accused
significance: The auto de fe at Logroño on November 7-8, 1610, culminated the Spanish Inquisition's investigation of the Basque witch panic at Zugarramurdi, burning six persons in effigy and two in person; the Inquisition subsequently commissioned Alonso de Salazar Frías's skeptical inquiry, which led to a general restraining of further prosecution and exemplifies the Spanish Inquisition's overall restraining role in witch-hunting.
source_method: Spanish Inquisition trial records; analyzed in Henningsen, The Witches' Advocate (1980)
